examples.en: Xu Erpao was brought to justice thanks to Comrade Yu Huanshui's act of bravery.
examples.zh: 徐二炮能顺利归案，得益于余欢水同志见义勇为的行为。

examples.en: When Xu Erpao lunged with his knife and you pressed forward instead of retreating—were you nervous at that moment?" "Not really.
examples.zh: 面对徐二炮伺过来的尖刀，您不退反进，那一刻，您紧张吗？」「没太紧张。
